note: Curated from NASA Curiosity blog posts, JPL/NASA releases and abstracts listed per entry. rover_at_or_before_sol = last msl_wp.json waypoint with sol <= sol (or post's first sol when no exact sol). rover_start_of_plan = last waypoint with sol < post's first sol (parking spot where workspace targets were usually observed). Positions are the rover reference point, not the target itself (arm targets are ~1-2 m in front; remote_feature entries are far away).

targets.name: Altadena
targets.kind: drill hole #43 (edge/transition of boxwork unit)
targets.what: Drilled over the weekend; hole imaged by Mastcam sol 4564. First boxwork-unit drill; CheMin found phyllosilicates largely absent from surrounding Layered Sulfate unit (GSA 2025).

targets.name: Valle de la Luna
targets.kind: drill hole #44 (bedrock block in Monte Grande hollow)
targets.what: Drilled weekend of Oct 18-19 2025; Hazcam 'caught in the act' and Mastcam hole image both sol 4693. Hollow sample: carbonate (JPL) / siderite (Seeger et al. 2026).

targets.name: Nevado Sajama
targets.kind: drill hole #45 (ridge top next to Monte Grande)
targets.what: 'The drill activity itself completed on Sol 4718.' Ridge sample: clay minerals (JPL). Site of 1.5-gigapixel 360 deg panorama, sols 4714-4741.

targets.name: Nevado Sajama2
targets.kind: drill hole (4th boxwork sample, a few cm from Nevado Sajama)
targets.what: Drilled the weekend after Jan 30 2026 planning for SAM's last TMAH wet-chemistry cup; Mastcam shows both holes side by side on sol 4795. Hole number not stated; Campo Marte is later called the 47th successful drill.

targets.name: Atacama
targets.kind: drill attempt (layered sulfate unit above boxwork)
targets.what: Drill sols 2-3 planned for sols 4876-4878 (exact drill sol not stated). Hole was made but the detached block lifted with the bit; freed in the sol 4883-4885 plan (Mastcam sol 4883, May 2 2026); tailings lost.

targets.name: Campo Marte
targets.kind: drill hole #47 'successful' (layered sulfate unit above boxwork)
targets.what: First color image of the hole sol 4897. Drilled only 28 mm deep (usual 35 mm). Same stratum as Atacama.

targets.name: Basque Lakes
targets.kind: drill hole #48 (Cache Creek quad; first drill above the erosional supersurface)
targets.what: MAHLI after preload test sol 5023; Navcam shows the hole and tailings sol 5024.

targets.name: Nazca
targets.kind: drill hole #49 (block packed with disc/needle-shaped potential crystal forms, next to Chiu Chiu)
targets.what: Mastcam image of the Nazca drill hole on sol 5050. Samples to CheMin and SAM; campaign wrapped up and drove away in the sol 5063-5069 week.

targets.name: Boxwork unit contact (first crossing)
targets.kind: geologic contact, Layered Sulfate unit to boxwork interval
targets.what: 'crossed the contact from the Layered Sulfate unit (LSu) on sol 4534 (5/7/2025)' (GSA 2025). Phase 1 of the campaign = sols 4534-4570.

targets.name: Glendale Peak
targets.kind: rugged top of a ridge defining a potential boxwork structure
targets.what: ChemCam LIBS + Mastcam on the ridge top.

targets.name: Sisquoc River / Palo Verde Mountains
targets.kind: resistant ridge-like features in the boxwork workspace
targets.what: Ridge composition via ChemCam (Sisquoc River) and APXS (Palo Verde Mountains).

targets.name: Camp Williams
targets.kind: sandy patches used as wind change-detection targets at the Altadena drill site
targets.what: Mastcam M100 repeat frames over many sols.

targets.name: Los Patos
targets.kind: depression, maybe a small impact crater or boxwork structure
targets.what: Mastcam mosaic.

targets.name: Laguna del Bayo
targets.kind: potential fracture fill in front of the parking spot
targets.what: Mastcam mosaic; Tarija = brushed typical bedrock nearby.

targets.name: Copacabana / Ardamarca
targets.kind: trough-floor bedrock (Copacabana) and a ridge parallel to the trough walls (Ardamarca)
targets.what: Contact science on trough bedrock; stereo mosaic of the ridge.

targets.name: Volcan Pena Blanca
targets.kind: prominent raised ridge with side + top view, at least three layers
targets.what: Imaged from ~10 m on sol 4591; contact science on upper (Parinacota, DRT+APXS) and middle (Wila Willki) outcrop; LIBS Pichu Pichu, Tacume. Phase 2 stop.

targets.name: Ouro
targets.kind: displaced block near a circular depression (possible small crater)
targets.what: Color imaging.

targets.name: Meson
targets.kind: ridge driven onto (15 m drive)
targets.what: Phase 3 (best-expressed boxwork) starts sol 4600.

targets.name: Totoral / Sillar
targets.kind: ridge-top parking chosen to compare ridge chemistry and texture with topographic lows
targets.what: APXS + MAHLI on different parts of the nodular bedrock; Vicuna = well-exposed vein (LIBS).

targets.name: Lake Titicaca
targets.kind: nodular rock pillar
targets.what: ChemCam LIBS.

targets.name: Punta de Lobos
targets.kind: rock with dendritic-looking texture
targets.what: Mastcam.

targets.name: Arequipa Airport
targets.kind: ridge the rover drove on; strata exposed underneath
targets.what: RMI + Mastcam M100 mosaics.

targets.name: Canon de Palca
targets.kind: bedrock next to a large fracture in the workspace
targets.what: DRT + APXS + MAHLI; Caine = boxwork ridges imaged.

targets.name: El Salto
targets.kind: target on the central line running along the big ridge (central fracture)
targets.what: APXS + MAHLI + ChemCam 'could get us a glimpse into what formed the central line'.

targets.name: Llullaillaco
targets.kind: small mound with veins and the hollow around it
targets.what: Mastcam.

targets.name: Salar de Agua Amara
targets.kind: delicate branching structures 'likely made by groundwater'
targets.what: MAHLI.

targets.name: Airport Domes
targets.kind: a hollow in the boxworks
targets.what: ChemCam LIBS.

targets.name: Pular / Socompa
targets.kind: resistant veins (filled fractures)
targets.what: APXS + MAHLI; LIBS on two similar veins.

targets.name: Lago Poopo / Vicguna
targets.kind: bright clean vein network (Lago Poopo); protruding vein edge with nodular texture (Vicguna)
targets.what: Vein campaign; Repechon = loose block with dark mottled material.

targets.name: Ayopaya
targets.kind: intersecting 'peace-sign-shaped' ridges
targets.what: Mastcam mosaic.

targets.name: Laguna Miniques
targets.kind: potential incipient hollow
targets.what: Mastcam.

targets.name: Asiruqucha
targets.kind: light-toned, small-scale nodular bedrock
targets.what: APXS.

targets.name: Rio Frio
targets.kind: prominent resistant ridge (wall imaged before arrival)
targets.what: Cusi Cusi = narrow sand-filled trough nearby.

targets.name: Minimini / El Tapado
targets.kind: nodule-filled target (APXS) and a vein (LIBS) at the Rio Frio ridge wall
targets.what: MAHLI pea-sized nodule image on sol 4636 (PIA26697).

targets.name: Samaipata / Wallatiri / Mojo
targets.kind: boxwork structures around the rover; Mojo = hollow
targets.what: Mastcam + MAHLI + APXS (Vitichi, Tartagalita).

targets.name: Tarapaca
targets.kind: regolith target inside a hollow (no bedrock in workspace)
targets.what: MAHLI + APXS; 12 m drive out of the hollow was challenging.

targets.name: Laguna Colorada / Jorginho Cove
targets.kind: ridge/hollow pair; ridge the rover was parked on plus next hollow south
targets.what: Mastcam mosaics.

targets.name: Ridge-to-hollow nodular transition
targets.kind: smooth ridge bedrock grading to nodular bedrock at a shallow hollow edge (unnamed)
targets.what: Navcam sol 4650; same measurements repeated on smooth vs nodular bedrock.

targets.name: Quechua / Chaco
targets.kind: bedrock ridge (Quechua) and a raised resistant bedrock feature (Chaco)
targets.what: ChemCam LIBS; hollow walls mosaicked.

targets.name: Boxwork panorama (PIA26693)
targets.kind: 179-image Mastcam panorama of ridges and hollows
targets.what: Taken sol 4671.

targets.name: Autobahn
targets.kind: one of the bigger ridges
targets.what: Driving route along ridges.

targets.name: Laguna Escondida / Laguna Socompa
targets.kind: two hollows on either side of the ridge
targets.what: Scouted as hollow drill sites.

targets.name: Monte Grande
targets.kind: large hollow; site of the Valle de la Luna drill and later polygon block
targets.what: Chosen hollow drill site (bedrock exposed). Revisited sols 4743-4749.

targets.name: Pachica
targets.kind: block with many nodules
targets.what: ChemCam LIBS for nodule chemical variability.

targets.name: Arenas Blancas / Camarones / Exaltacion
targets.kind: veins on the ridge near Nevado Sajama
targets.what: 'more insight into the fluids that penetrated the boxwork ridges, perhaps contributing to their erosion resistance'.

targets.name: Monte Grande polygon block
targets.kind: polygon-covered, rubbly block on the hollow floor next to Valle de la Luna
targets.what: Super-sized MAHLI mosaic for 3D model; APXS/LIBS on polygon centers vs ridges; scuffed light-toned bedrock.

targets.name: Altiplano
targets.kind: ridge with a central fracture; ridge-wall transect between the two drill holes
targets.what: Chemistry + imaging of the wall from Valle de la Luna (hollow) to Nevado Sajama (ridge).

targets.name: Tiquipaya
targets.kind: rock broken by the wheels, exposing bright white material
targets.what: ChemCam LIBS.

targets.name: Los Flamencos
targets.kind: narrow ridge with many small branching ridges (and a hollow with interesting floor bedrock seen from orbit)
targets.what: Phase 4 (final look, contacts) starts sol 4805.

targets.name: Tapiche
targets.kind: hollow where the rover parked
targets.what: Mosaics deeper into the hollow.

targets.name: Infiernillo / Humahuaca
targets.kind: bedrock at the eastern extent of the boxwork unit; nodule-rich bedrock
targets.what: DRT + APXS + MAHLI; LIBS.

targets.name: Timboy Chaco
targets.kind: pitted vertical rock face
targets.what: MAHLI merge sol 4827.

targets.name: Thola
targets.kind: dark float rock, possible stony meteorite
targets.what: APXS + MAHLI + ChemCam reflectance.

targets.name: El Misti / Yungas
targets.kind: southern contact between boxworks and layered sulfate unit (19x3 mosaic); highly veined area
targets.what: Mastcam mosaics along the contact.

targets.name: Toro Wharku / Sierra Gorda / Santa Laura
targets.kind: last boxwork-unit workspaces: brushed bedrock, layered bedrock, dark ridge
targets.what: 'Wrapping Up the Boxwork Terrain'.

targets.name: Southern contact crossing / Santa Rosa
targets.kind: layered sulfate unit bedrock just across the southernmost boxwork contact (third contact crossing)
targets.what: 'Last weekend's drive took us just over the southernmost contact' (weekend plan sols 4842-4844, waypoint sol 4844); rover repositioned to brush Santa Rosa; Piedra Colgada = fine nodules eroded from bedrock; Wednesday's ~50 m drive (waypoint 4848) reached polygonal resistant ridges (Ocharaza, Nevado Tres Cruces). Navcam of polygonal sulfate unit sol 4848.

targets.name: Antofagasta
targets.kind: small crater ~10 m across, possibly <50 Myr old
targets.what: Team decided against drilling in or around it (sand fill).

targets.name: Erosional supersurface
targets.kind: possible regional erosional surface: light-toned rocks under dark rocks
targets.what: Navcam sol 4963; Monte Darwin (APXS) at its base; Cerro Paine Grande vertical exposure below it.

targets.name: Chiu Chiu / Salar de Vacas
targets.kind: blocks full of disc-shaped lumps 3-4 mm across, ~1 mm thick
targets.what: Possible crystal growth habit or broken-up harder layer; first imaged in the sol 5010-5015 plans.

targets.kind: crystal-form-rich target near Nazca
targets.what: LIBS depth profile.

targets.name: Mishe Mokwa

targets.what: RMI and Mastcam of its stratigraphy.

targets.what: RMI mosaics.

targets.name: Paniri

targets.what: RMI.

targets.name: Valle Grande
targets.kind: named valley the rover climbs after the boxwork (region)
targets.what: Route up Mount Sharp.

targets.name: Kimsa Chata
targets.kind: butte (remote)
targets.what: Mastcam.
